name: Apricot & Turkish delight mess
assumptions: Yield of 2 inferred from dividing mixture between 2 dessert glasses/bowls in instructions.
Preparation time of 10 minutes estimated for whisking, folding, dividing, and decorating (no cooking involved).
Meringue nests assumed to contain egg whites (common in standard recipes).
Turkish delight assumed free of wheat/starch-based coatings unless specified; sesame status ambiguous as some varieties include sesame.
Mint classified as decoration/folding ingredient with negligible impact on diets/allergens.
All classifications based strictly on listed ingredients without assuming unlisted additives or processing.
instructions:
step 1
Place the mascarpone, yogurt, sugar and orange flower water into a large bowl and whisk until thickened. Fold the remaining ingredients through, then divide the mix between 2 dessert glasses or bowls and decorate with extra mint, if you like.

ingredients.name: Mascarpone
ingredients.assumptions: Standard full-fat mascarpone cheese values; entire 100g used as listed.

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: Plain full-fat Greek yogurt; entire 50g used as listed.

ingredients.name: Icing Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Standard powdered icing sugar; entire 25g used as listed.

ingredients.name: Orange Blossom Water
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons orange blossom water estimated at 30g total; negligible macros, treated as water/flavoring.

ingredients.name: Meringue Nests
ingredients.assumptions: 1 standard small meringue nest estimated at 25g (typical single nest weight); high-sugar baked meringue.

ingredients.name: Apricot
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium fresh apricots estimated at 90g each (edible portion with stone removed); raw state per recipe folding step.

ingredients.name: Turkish Delight
ingredients.assumptions: 2 standard pieces rose-flavored Turkish delight estimated at 20g each (typical bite-size); high-sugar confectionery.

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.assumptions: Toasted or flaked almonds as listed; entire 25g used.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.assumptions: 4 fresh mint leaves estimated at ~2g each (total 8g); used as decoration and folded in, negligible but included for completeness.
